raw_translation: Hii ni mbili-team kujifunza toleo na wazi rahisi sheria ya nyumba, si mashindano ya mwamuzi au simulation halisi ya kila aina ya kikanda. profile Argentina ni pamoja na moja rahisi envido tu, hakuna flor au chained envidos. Paulista profile hutumia rahisi nne-mchezaji mzunguko na haina kutekeleza mashindano ya ubaguzi kama vile mão de onze. Mitaa sheria tofauti; kukubaliana na wasifu kabla ya kucheza. Kadi zote, matokeo na hatua kukaa katika kivinjari hiki.
source: This is a two-team learning version with explicit simplified house rules, not a tournament referee or an exact simulation of every regional variation. The Argentine profile includes one simple envido only, no flor or chained envidos. The Paulista profile uses a simplified four-player round and does not implement tournament exceptions such as mão de onze. Local rules differ; agree the profile before playing. All cards, scores and actions stay in this browser.
translation: Hii ni mbili-team kujifunza toleo na wazi rahisi sheria ya nyumba, si mashindano ya mwamuzi au simulation halisi ya kila aina ya kikanda. profile Argentina ni pamoja na moja rahisi envido tu, hakuna flor au chained envidos. Paulista profile hutumia rahisi nne-mchezaji mzunguko na haina kutekeleza mashindano ya ubaguzi kama vile mão de onze. Mitaa sheria tofauti; kukubaliana na wasifu kabla ya kucheza. Kadi zote, matokeo na hatua kukaa katika kivinjari hiki.

raw_translation: Hii kuandika kasi ya mtihani ripoti maneno jumla kwa dakika kwa kutumia kiwango cha alama tano-kwa-neno mkataba, plus wahusika sahihi na usahihi. Timer hutumia muda uliopita kivinjari, na keystrokes yako si kupakuliwa au kuhifadhiwa.
source: This typing speed test reports gross words per minute using the standard five-characters-per-word convention, plus correct characters and accuracy. The timer uses elapsed browser time, and your keystrokes are not uploaded or stored.
translation: Hii kuandika kasi ya mtihani ripoti maneno jumla kwa dakika kwa kutumia kiwango cha alama tano-kwa-neno mkataba, plus wahusika sahihi na usahihi. Timer hutumia muda uliopita kivinjari, na keystrokes yako si kupakuliwa au kuhifadhiwa.

raw_translation: Tracker hii haipendekezi chanjo, dozi, wakati au uwezekano. Kuthibitisha ratiba yako binafsi na daktari au mamlaka ya afya ya mitaa. Inatuma ukumbusho hakuna na haihifadhi entries yako.
source: This tracker does not recommend vaccines, doses, timing or eligibility. Confirm your personal schedule with a clinician or local health authority. It sends no reminders and does not save your entries.
translation: Tracker hii haipendekezi chanjo, dozi, wakati au uwezekano. Kuthibitisha ratiba yako binafsi na daktari au mamlaka ya afya ya mitaa. Inatuma ukumbusho hakuna na haihifadhi entries yako.
